Task: Fix ansible-doc terminal rendering of documentation macros.

Status: Implemented DocCLI.tty_ify in lib/ansible/cli/doc.py. It renders I, B, M, U, C, L, R, and HORIZONTALLINE and preserves unsupported parenthesized words. Added focused unit coverage in test/units/cli/test_doc.py.

Validation: `PYTHONPATH=lib:test/units python -m pytest -q test/units/cli/test_doc.py test/units/cli/test_cli.py` passed (30 tests). `git diff --check` passed. `rg` is unavailable; local inspection used grep/find instead.

--- a/lib/ansible/cli/doc.py

@@ -8,6 +8,7 @@ __metaclass__ = type

@@ -71,6 +72,37 @@ class DocCLI(CLI):
     # default ignore list for detailed views
     IGNORE = ('module', 'docuri', 'version_added', 'short_description', 'now_date', 'plainexamples', 'returndocs', 'collection')
 
+    _DOC_MACRO = re.compile(
+        r'(?<!\w)(?:'
+        r'(?P<single>[IBMUC])\((?P<value>[^)]+)\)'
+        r'|(?P<paired>[LR])\((?P<label>[^,)]+),[ ]*(?P<target>[^)]+)\)'
+        r'|(?P<rule>HORIZONTALLINE)(?!\w)'
+        r')'
+    )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tty_ify(cls, text):
+        def render(match):
+            macro = match.group('single')
+            if macro:
+                value = match.group('value')
+                if macro in ('I', 'C'):
+                    return '`%s\'' % value
+                if macro == 'B':
+                    return '*%s*' % value
+                if macro == 'M':
+                    return '[%s]' % value
+                return value
+
+            paired = match.group('paired')
+            if paired == 'L':
+                return '%s <%s>' % (match.group('label'), match.group('target'))
+            if paired == 'R':
+                return match.group('label')
+            return '\n-------------\n'
+
+        return cls._DOC_MACRO.sub(render, text)
+
     def __init__(self, args):
 
         super(DocCLI, self).__init__(args)

+# Copyright: (c) 2026, Ansible Project
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from units.compat import unittest
+
+from ansible.cli.doc import DocCLI
+
+
+class TestDocCLITtyIfy(unittest.TestCase):
+
+    def test_documentation_macros(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            DocCLI.tty_ify('I(italic) B(bold) M(module) U(url) C(value)'),
+            "`italic' *bold* [module] url `value'",
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('L(link,https://example.org)'), 'link <https://example.org>')
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('L(link, https://example.org)'), 'link <https://example.org>')
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('R(reference,ref)'), 'reference')
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('R(reference, ref)'), 'reference')
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('HORIZONTALLINE'), '\n-------------\n')
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('before HORIZONTALLINE after'), 'before \n-------------\n after')
+
+    def test_multiple_macros_and_plain_text(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            DocCLI.tty_ify('Use M(name), B(text), C(value), and R(label, ref). IBM(International Business Machines) stays.'),
+            "Use [name], *text*, `value', and label. IBM(International Business Machines) stays.",
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(DocCLI.tty_ify('M(name)B(text)C(value)R(label,ref)'), "[name]*text*`value'label")
+
+    def test_unsupported_parenthesized_words(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            DocCLI.tty_ify('IBM(International Business Machines) XL(link,url) RH(text,ref) SOME(value)'),
+            'IBM(International Business Machines) XL(link,url) RH(text,ref) SOME(value)',
+        )
